weapon.d:
Inflicts Atk/Spd/Def/Res-5 on foes within 3 rows or 3 columns centered on unit and neutralizes effects that grant "Special cooldown charge +X" to those foes during their combat.
At start of combat, if unit's HP ≥ 25%, unit deals +X × 5 damage during combat (max 20; X = number of foes within 3 spaces of target, including target; excluding area-of-effect Specials).

c.d:
At start of turn, if any foe is in cardinal directions of unit, grants【Charge】to unit for 1 turn.
【Charge】
